notes: Jaden McDaniels dropped 32 points, 10 rebounds and 4 threes on 11-15 shooting for Thug Life, and Wembanyama's 44 and 16 for Nova Knicks stayed second-best.
Darius Acuff Jr. posted 22 points and 9 assists for theInfamous but needed 24 shots, going 9-24 FG, a brick with a nice stat line.
Left on the bench: nothing. Nobody forgot a starter, so there is no bench blunder to hang on any manager tonight.
De'Anthony Melton hit 8 threes for 24 points and 7 assists, and he is still on the wire. Caruso (4 BLK) and Gui Santos (22 PTS) too.
Thug Life went 7-3-1 against MONSTARS and won the night. BrookynDynasty went 6-4-1, still a win, but it was the worst night of the 12 teams.
